tools.name: cst_create_project
tools.description: Create a new CST Studio Suite project file. In connected mode the project is created directly; in offline mode a VBA script is returned for manual execution.

path.description: Full file path for the new project, e.g. 'C:/cst_projects/MyAntenna.cst'.

project_type.description: CST project type. One of: MWS (Microwave Studio), EMS (EM Studio), PS (Particle Studio), MPS (Mphysics Studio), CS (Cable Studio), DS (Design Studio), PCB (PCB Studio).

tools.name: cst_open_project
tools.description: Open an existing CST Studio Suite project. In connected mode the project is opened in the running instance; in offline mode a reference is stored for subsequent operations.

path.description: Full file path of the existing .cst project to open.

tools.name: cst_save_project
tools.description: Save the currently open CST project. Optionally provide a new path to 'Save As'.

path.description: Optional file path for 'Save As'. If omitted, saves to the current project path.
